spec_match.rationale: Measures the three declaration orderings against the cascade with computed font-stretch read-backs and ships a two-step detection helper (parse check plus computed confirmation) for both the property and the FontFace object model.

interactive.rationale: Measure-all-three re-runs the ordering experiment on real elements and the helper results render live; verified the run produced per-ordering computed values and expectations.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises three orderings measured with the non-obvious answer, and the page delivers with per-ordering verdicts.

edge_cases.rationale: The new-name-only silent no-op is the page's centrepiece failure mode, and the FontFace expando trap is called out with its own live check.

conformance.rationale: The suite's computed-effect assertions back this page's measurements; on Chromium 141 /conformance/ honestly reported 2 pass / 5 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): measured all three orderings — old-then-new and new-then-old both computed 125%, new-only computed 100% instead of 75%, and the detail correctly identified the silent no-op; helper returned font-stretch, object-model check returned stretch; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs the per-ordering computed results.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, focusable helper code block, ordering panels with per-panel verdicts, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: aria-live detail, results conveyed as text, single labelled 44px button, focusable code blocks.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/fontface-width-attribute-and-font-width-descriptor/writing-for-both/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). On this pre-rename build the ordering experiment produced its most instructive outcome: the new-name-only panel computed 100% instead of 75%, which the page correctly identified as the silent no-op that the old-then-new ordering protects against, and both detection helpers returned the honest 'font-stretch'/'stretch' answers. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; desktop and mobile screenshots read with no overflow; /conformance/ honestly reported 2 pass / 5 fail. Clears the bar with no follow-ups.
